record: Amendment A2 -- clarification C3 (learned outcome-prediction model specification)
type: post-hoc pre-training clarification; separate file, linked by hash; A2, C1 and C2 are not modified

linked_to.relationship: A2 -> C1 -> C2 -> C3. C3 adds the learned-model specification, which no earlier record contained; it changes nothing in A2, C1 or C2.

provenance.origin_of_model_family: the pre-Spec design audit (proposed_experiment.json: 'Gradient-boosted regression trees') was never carried into Spec v1/v2; C3 makes it concrete by user decision
provenance.note: the effective configuration below was read from unfitted estimator objects (get_params); no estimator was fitted

estimators.structure: one independently fitted regressor per (target, prediction type)

configuration.inactive_given_config: n_iter_no_change, scoring, tol and validation_fraction have no effect because early_stopping = False; categorical_features='from_dtype' treats no feature as categorical because the input is a float64 NumPy array
configuration.no_search: no hyperparameter or grid search; there is exactly one configuration, so there is NO configuration-selection step
configuration.c2_score_not_used_for_model_selection: the C2 baseline-selection score governs only the four non-learning baselines; learned-model VALIDATION losses are reported descriptively

inputs.descriptor_source: candidate_action_set.json encoding for the candidate_id only
inputs.zero_variance_features: in_transit_R2_C1, in_transit_R3_C2 and in_transit_R4_C2 remain model inputs unchanged (A2 whitelist); the C2 exclusion applies only to state-space distances (1-NN baseline and OOD)
inputs.preprocessing: none (tree model; no scaling of model inputs)
inputs.runtime_assertion: list(input_columns) == the 54-name order above, before every fit and predict (A2 Issue 6)

training_data.rows: all TRAIN candidate rows (5,985 states x 298), each with equal weight (A2 Issue 3; no sample_weight passed)
training_data.T90_rows: rows with T90 reached before the decision are kept (A2 Issue 3)
training_data.validation_use: VALIDATION is used only to report losses, MAE, coverage, quantile crossing and the selector comparison, and to set the learned selector's own tolerances and interval-width threshold (C2)

quantile_crossing.raw_predictions: q0.1, q0.5 and q0.9 are predicted independently and recorded raw
quantile_crossing.diagnostic: the pre-correction crossing rate (share of rows where q0.1 > q0.5 or q0.5 > q0.9) is reported per target
quantile_crossing.rearrangement_for_selector: for selector consumption only, the three values of each row are sorted ascending (q0.1 <= q0.5 <= q0.9); deterministic
quantile_crossing.mean_independent: the conditional-mean prediction is never replaced by q0.5; MAE always uses the conditional mean

learned_selector_tolerances.rule: C2 exactly: delta_U = 0.5 x learned-model VALIDATION conditional-mean MAE on future_unmet; delta_H = 0.5 x learned-model VALIDATION conditional-mean MAE on future_hazard_unmet; delta_T90 = delta_T100 = 0.5 tick
learned_selector_tolerances.not_used: the exact-input baseline's delta_U = 5.055 and delta_H = 5.041 (frozen for the baseline selector only)

reproducibility_after_training.serialization: each of the 16 fitted estimators is serialized with pickle (protocol 5) and its SHA-256 recorded, together with the environment versions above and the SHA-256 of the exact training input and target arrays
